Commentary: England Squad: Tom Banton, Ben Duckett, Joe Root, Harry Brook(c), Jordan Cox(w), Will Jacks, Jamie Overton, Liam Dawson, Gus Atkinson, Sonny Baker, Adil Rashid, Mason Crane, Sam Curran, Josh Tongue, Henry Crocombe, James Coles

Pakistan Squad: Fakhar Zaman, Saim Ayub, Babar Azam, Saad Baig(w), Salman Agha, Hasan Nawaz, Arafat Minhas, Faheem Ashraf, Shaheen Afridi(c), Naseem Shah, Haris Rauf, Abrar Ahmed, Shadab Khan, Ghazi Ghori, Sufyan Moqim, Razaullah
Squads:

Sonny Baker to Arafat Minhas, out Caught by Harry Brook!! Arafat Minhas holes out! A good knock from Minhas nonetheless. He gives himself room and it's a length delivery in line of the stumps. He swings across the line but ends up getting a leading edge to mid-off. Brook takes a few steps behind and reverse-cups it with ease. Arafat Minhas c Harry Brook b Sonny Baker 59(58) [4s-9]
Shaheen Afridi, left handed bat, comes to the crease
Sam Curran to Faheem Ashraf, 1 run, slower low full-toss on off, Faheem Ashraf drills it to wide long-off
Sam Curran to Shaheen Afridi, 1 run, slower length delivery on off, Shaheen Afridi plays it with soft hands to wide mid-on for a single
Sam Curran to Faheem Ashraf, THATS OUT!! Caught!!

Sam Curran to Faheem Ashraf, out Caught by Will Jacks!! The slower short delivery does the trick! Sam Curran digs this one into the surface on off. Faheem Ashraf is early into the pull and miscues it towards deep mid-wicket. Will Jacks stationed there is safe as houses. End of a breezy cameo from Ashraf. Faheem Ashraf c Will Jacks b Sam Curran 39(26) [4s-5 6s-1]
Naseem Shah, right handed bat, comes to the crease
Sam Curran to Naseem Shah, 1 run, 83.3kph moon ball on a length on off, Naseem Shah punches it to wide long-on
Sam Curran to Shaheen Afridi, FOUR, slammed! In the slot on off, Shaheen Afridi clears his front leg and smashes it through mid-on. The ball travels to the fence at the rate of knots
Sam Curran to Shaheen Afridi, FOUR, two fours in a row for Shaheen Afridi! A half-volley outside off, Shaheen Afridi reaches out and crunches it over covers. Sweeper cover has no chance to stop it
England have been penalised for slow over-rate. They have to bring an extra fielder inside the ring for the final over

Sonny Baker to Naseem Shah, leg byes, 1 run, 138.5kph skiddy good length delivery angling down leg, Naseem Shah tries to swipe it across but it deflects off his pads to the right of the keeper. Shaheen Afridi calls him through for a brisk single

Sonny Baker to Shaheen Afridi, leg byes, 1 run, Shaheen Afridi backs away and Sonny Baker follows him with a very full delivery. He tries to whip it across but it deflects off his pads to covers for a leg bye
Sonny Baker to Naseem Shah, THATS OUT!! Caught!!

Sonny Baker to Naseem Shah, out Caught by Jamie Overton!! On a length around off, Naseem Shah tries to hit it downtown but only manages to get it off the inner half to long-on. A straightforward catch for Overton who accepts it gleefully. Naseem Shah c Jamie Overton b Sonny Baker 1(3)
Haris Rauf, right handed bat, comes to the crease

Sonny Baker to Haris Rauf, byes, 1 run, yorker length delivery tailing in, Haris Rauf swings at it but misses. The ball flies past the stumps. Jordan Cox dives to his left to stop it. Shaheen Afridi scampers across to the other end
Sonny Baker to Shaheen Afridi, 1 run, well bowled! A yorker length delivery on leg-stump, Shaheen Afridi whips it off the inner half towards deep square leg. Just a single

Sonny Baker to Haris Rauf, FOUR, Haris Rauf finishes with a boundary as Pakistan breach 300! A length delivery in line of the stumps, Haris Rauf clears his front leg and swipes it over wide mid-on. Bisects the two fielders in the deep to perfection
Welcome back. The chase about to begin.
Tom Banton and Ben Duckett are at the crease. Tom Banton is on strike. Shaheen Afridi will open the attack
Shaheen Afridi to Tom Banton, no run
Shaheen Afridi to Tom Banton, 2 runs, to mid-wicket
Shaheen Afridi to Tom Banton, no run, the ball bends in from a length and has been stabbed back to the bowler
Shaheen Afridi to Tom Banton, no run, 134.3 kph, angled across, left alone to the keeper
Shaheen Afridi to Tom Banton, no run
Shaheen Afridi to Tom Banton, wide, fuller length delivery, outside off, well wide and Tom Banton looks to drive and gets beaten. The keeper dives to his right to stop it. One extra added
Shaheen Afridi to Tom Banton, no run, pats a length delivery to the left of mid-off and
Naseem Shah, right-arm fast, comes into the attack
Naseem Shah to Ben Duckett, no run, stabs a length delivery, outside off, patted down to point
Naseem Shah to Ben Duckett, no run, back of a length delivery, outside off, Ben Duckett pats the ball down into the off-side
Naseem Shah to Ben Duckett, 1 run, fuller length delivery, angled in, Ben Duckett clips the ball wide of mid-on for a single
